source: Directive (EU) 2017/1132 relating to certain aspects of company law, Art. 26 (letters and order forms), with the national rules that carry it: GmbHG 35a and HGB 37a in Germany, aktiebolagslagen 28 kap. 5 § in Sweden. Only the requirements are cited.

rules.text: A company's letters and order forms state the register and registration number, the legal form and the registered office; a GmbH also names its managing directors. When the files do not give them, the reply says which are missing.
